column20: What Happened: the immediate trigger was a bug in the dashboard; Timeline 16:32 new dashboard version released
column21: How we responded: a failure in the control plane which has strict separation of concerns from the data plane
column22: broad outage of many of our APIs and the Cloudflare Dashboard; Tenant Service is part of our API request authorization logic
column23: Dashboard availability: the dashboard was severely impacted throughout the full duration of the incident
column25: How we responded: increasing the resources helped with availability but was insufficient to restore normal service; the patch degraded service further and was quickly reverted; Timeline 19:12 recovered
column26: Timeline 17:50 a new version of the Tenant API Service is deployed and 17:57 the service becomes overwhelmed; Tenant Service is part of our API request authorization logic
column28: Trigger was a dashboard code bug whose retries overwhelmed the shared Tenant Service API during a service update; automatic rollback was not in place.
